nodes.label: BabyShalls D2C Single-Door Hub
nodes.rationale: Transition BabyShalls from 7+ years on Shopee and Instagram into an independent direct-to-consumer boutique platform in Kota Malang.

nodes.label: BabyShalls AI Agent Context & Workspace Guide
nodes.norm_label: babyshalls ai agent context & workspace guide

nodes.label: Architecture Blueprint v1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Adopts a Decoupled Modern Monolith / Two-Tier Modular System to maximize SEO with Next.js SSR, isolate payment/shipping logic in Express, and keep total RAM under 2 GB on a 4 GB VPS.

nodes.label: BabyShalls Design System & Brand Style Guide v2.0
nodes.norm_label: babyshalls design system & brand style guide v2.0

nodes.label: Strict Anti-Bias Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Prevent legacy bias and scope creep by enforcing single-store D2C, no heavy AI microservice in Phase 1, fixed Kota Malang logistics origin, Redis graceful fallback, and modular TypeScript components.

nodes.label: Redis Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Caches KiriminAja shipping rates (60m TTL), popular catalog queries (15m TTL), and Midtrans idempotency keys (24h TTL) to save up to 85% API quota and cut checkout latency from ~800ms to under 5ms.

nodes.label: The Cozy Living Storybook Design Philosophy
nodes.norm_label: the cozy living storybook design philosophy
nodes.rationale: Evokes an open children's book cover using warm cream/peach/terracotta tokens, Playfair Display + Nunito typography, and organic SVG waves instead of rigid boxy banners.

nodes.label: BabyShalls Engineering Guardrails (Rules 01-08)
nodes.rationale: Locks scope to single-store Malang boutique, forbids Phase 1 AI microservices, enforces atomic <=250-line components, Decimal currency fields, Redis graceful degradation, and webhook idempotency to ship in 4 weeks.

nodes.label: Redis Cache-Aside Pattern with Graceful Fallback
nodes.norm_label: redis cache-aside pattern with graceful fallback
nodes.rationale: Checks Redis first, falls back to KiriminAja or PostgreSQL on cache miss or unreachable Redis server so checkout flow never crashes.

nodes.label: Midtrans Webhook SHA-512 Verification & CORS Whitelist
nodes.norm_label: midtrans webhook sha-512 verification & cors whitelist
nodes.rationale: Verifies SHA-512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + ServerKey) before marking orders PAID and restricts backend access via CORS whitelist.
